title: Add starter files for tutorials 08–09
description:
## Summary
- Adds starter files for `08-functions-validation-quarto/` (validation.qmd + Algeria.csv)
- Adds starter files for `09-functions_validation-nhanes-quarto/` (nhanes_validation.qmd + 2 CSV data files)

The `packages-whole-game` tutorial (folder 10) does not need starter files — learners run `usethis::create_package()` directly in Workbench.

## Notes
- NHANES datasets exported from academyDatasets as CSVs with factor columns re-applied via `mutate(across(..., as.factor))` in the starter file
- Tested `usethis::create_package()` in both RStudio and Positron on Workbench — works fine once devtools is installed

## Test plan
- [ ] Clone repo in Workbench, verify folders 08–09 exist
- [ ] Open `08-functions-validation-quarto/validation.qmd`, render successfully
- [ ] Open `09-functions_validation-nhanes-quarto/nhanes_validation.qmd`, verify CSV data loads

title: Add 07-code_best_practices-quarto starter files
description:
## Summary
- Adds starter file (`functions.qmd`) and data files for the Code Best Practices IDE tutorial
- Contains the initial `aus_elec_data()` function that learners will refactor during the tutorial
- Three Australian electricity demand CSV files in `data/`

## Context
The `code_best_practices-quarto` tutorial in the pinr course was originally converted as a fullscreen tutorial but QA review (issue rstudio/academyTutorials#578) identified it needs IDE interaction — learners need a real file to edit as they refactor functions incrementally. It has been re-converted as an IDE tutorial in rstudio/academyTutorials.

## Test plan
- [ ] Clone this branch and verify the folder structure matches what the tutorial references (`07-code_best_practices-quarto/functions.qmd`)
- [ ] Open `functions.qmd` in an IDE and confirm it renders without error
- [ ] Verify all three CSV files are present in `data/`
